补充协议 / SUPPLEMENTAL AGREEMENT

本补充协议于2027年7月9日由下列各方签订 / This Supplemental Agreement is dated 9 July 2027 and made between:

甲方 / Party A: 苏州维澜精密机械有限公司 (Suzhou Weilan Precision Machinery Co., Ltd.)
注册地址 / Registered address: 苏州市工业园区星湖街218号生物纳米园A3幢6层
授权代表 / Authorised representative: 温砚清 (Wen Yanqing), 总经理

乙方 / Party B: Arclight Industrial GmbH
Registered office: Ludwigstrasse 27, 80539 Munich, Germany
Authorised representative: Katharina Brunnhuber-Lang, Head of Procurement

第一条 / Clause 1 采购数量与价格 / Volume and Price
乙方同意在2028年12月31日前向甲方采购精密导轨组件，合同总金额为欧元3,750,000（EUR 3,750,000）。首付款人民币8,200,000元应于2027年8月15日前支付。

第二条 / Clause 2 通知 / Notices
甲方通知联系人 / Party A contact: 温砚清, 电话 +86 512-6288-4417, 邮箱 wenyanqing@weilan-precision.com
乙方通知联系人 / Party B contact: Katharina Brunnhuber-Lang, telephone +49 89 5550 2281, email k.brunnhuber@arclight-ind.de
抄送 / Copy to: 甲方法务部 legal@weilan-precision.com

第三条 / Clause 3 适用法律 / Governing Law
本补充协议适用中华人民共和国法律 / This Supplemental Agreement is governed by the laws of the People's Republic of China. 争议提交上海国际经济贸易仲裁委员会仲裁 / Disputes shall be referred to the Shanghai International Arbitration Center.

notes: Bilingual parallel text. The same party and the same date each appear in two scripts, and both surface forms are separately gold: redacting only one leaks the other. Same for the consideration, written once in Chinese and once in ISO form. This fragment is the main probe for a model that silently drops the non-dominant language of a mixed chunk.
